name: China Southern international student fares
summary: Student fares and extra checked bags between Australia and mainland China for students aged 12 to 29 studying outside their home country.
who: Students aged 12 to 29 who attend a regular school in a country or region other than their country of nationality.
catches: Only for travel between Australia/New Zealand and mainland China.
All trips must be completed before your 30th birthday.
The discount rate is set after verification. The page is from 2021, so check it is still current.
